quotes: Our proposed IA2 → SFT training method outperforms standard SFT across the board.
contradictions.location: Table 1 caption and AGN → BBCN evaluation row
contradictions.description: The caption claims improvement across the board, but the BBCN evaluation reports lower accuracy for IA2 → SFT (27.9) than for SFT only (31.8). Calibration improves in this row, but accuracy does not.
